title: Greetings
description: Open and close a conversation without sounding like a textbook.

questions.sentence: Nomoskar, apni kemon achhen?
questions.translatedSentence: I am well, thank you.

questions.sentence: Ami bhalo achi.
Ki khobor?
questions.translatedSentence: Everything is good.

questions.sentence: Tumi kemon achho?
Ami bhalo achi, tumi kemon achho?
questions.translatedSentence: I am well too.

questions.sentence: Ami khub bhalo achi.
Tomar shorir bhalo to?
questions.translatedSentence: No, I am a little unwell.

questions.sentence: Ami ektu klanto achi.
Ki khobor, sob thik to?
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, everything is fine.

questions.sentence: Shubho sokal! Ghum kemon holo?
questions.translatedSentence: I slept very well, thank you.

questions.sentence: Shubho sokal, ami ekhon cha banai.
options: Good morning, I am making tea now.
Good morning, I am drinking tea now.
Good evening, I am making tea now.
questions.correctAnswer: Good morning, I am making tea now.

questions.sentence: Ashun, bhitore ashun.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, I am coming in.

questions.sentence: Amader barite apnake shagotom.
options: Thank you for coming to our home.

questions.sentence: Onek raat holo, ami ekhon jai.
questions.translatedSentence: Good night, sleep well.

questions.sentence: Shubho sondhya, apni ki cha khaben?
options: Good evening, will you have some tea?
Good morning, will you have some tea?
Good evening, do you want to go home?
questions.correctAnswer: Good evening, will you have some tea?

questions.sentence: Boshun, ekhoni cha ashche.
options: Na, ami cha banate jani na.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, I am sitting down.

questions.sentence: Bhalo kore ghumao, kal sokale dekha hobe.
options: Sleep well, we will meet tomorrow morning.
Wake up early, we will meet tomorrow morning.
Sleep well, we will meet tonight.
questions.correctAnswer: Sleep well, we will meet tomorrow morning.

questions.sentence: Shubho sokal! Aj kothay jachchen?
questions.translatedSentence: I am going to work.

questions.sentence: Onek dhonyobad, apni amake khub sahajyo korechen.
options: Kono bepar na, eta to kichui na.
questions.correctAnswer: Kono bepar na, eta to kichui na.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem at all, it was nothing.

questions.sentence: Ami dukkhito, amar deri hoye gelo.
options: I am sorry, I am late.
Excuse me, I am leaving now.
questions.correctAnswer: I am sorry, I am late.

questions.sentence: Kichu mone korben na, ektu shunben?
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, tell me what you need.

questions.sentence: Doya kore ektu opekkha korun.
Ami tomar boi ta hariye felechi, dukkhito.
questions.translatedSentence: It is okay, do not worry.

questions.sentence: Kichu mone korben na, ami ektu jete chai.
options: Excuse me, I would like to get through.
Excuse me, I would like to sit down.
Sorry, I do not want to go.
questions.correctAnswer: Excuse me, I would like to get through.

questions.sentence: Ei nin apnar cha.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you very much, you are very kind.

questions.sentence: Maaf korben, ami bujhte parini.
options: Excuse me, I do not know the way.

questions.sentence: Doya kore aro ektu aste bolun.
options: Ami jore kotha bolte pari na.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, I will speak slowly.

questions.sentence: Ami ekhon aschi, onek deri hoye gelo.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, go safely.

questions.sentence: Abar dekha hobe, bhalo theko.
Kalke abar dekha hobe to?
options: Na, ami kal ke chini na.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we will meet tomorrow morning.

questions.sentence: Ami ekhon berochchi, pore phone korbo.
options: I am leaving now, I will call later.
I am leaving now, I will come later.
I am waiting here, I will call later.
questions.correctAnswer: I am leaving now, I will call later.

questions.sentence: Ashi tahole, bhalo thakben.
questions.translatedSentence: You take care too.

questions.sentence: Sabdhane bari jeo, onek raat hoye geche.
options: Get home safely, it has gotten very late.
Come home early, it has gotten very late.
Get home safely, it is raining hard.
questions.correctAnswer: Get home safely, it has gotten very late.

questions.sentence: Amar tram ta chole elo, ami tahole ashi.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, we will talk later.

questions.sentence: Aj ashi, kal abar kotha hobe.
options: I am off now, we will talk again tomorrow.
I am off now, I will come again tomorrow.
I am staying today, we will talk in the evening.
questions.correctAnswer: I am off now, we will talk again tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Bhalo theko, nijer jotno nio.
questions.translatedSentence: You take care of yourself too.

questions.sentence: Kaku, apni kemon achhen? Onek din apnake dekhini.
options: Ami bhalo achi baba, tumi kemon achho?
Ami tomake chini na, tumi ke?
questions.correctAnswer: Ami bhalo achi baba, tumi kemon achho?
questions.translatedSentence: I am well, dear, and how are you?

questions.sentence: Boroder sathe amra apni kore kotha boli.
options: With elders we speak using the polite form.
With friends we speak using the polite form.
With elders we do not speak very much.
questions.correctAnswer: With elders we speak using the polite form.

questions.sentence: Mashi, ami ki apnake ektu sahajyo korte pari?
options: Haan baba, ei jhola ta ektu dhoro.
Na, ami tomake sahajyo korte parbo na.
Ami ei jhola ta bajar theke kinechi.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan baba, ei jhola ta ektu dhoro.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes dear, please hold this bag for a moment.

questions.sentence: Apni doya kore ektu ekhane boshun, dada ekhoni ashben.
options: Please sit here for a moment, my brother will come shortly.
Please wait outside, my brother will come shortly.
Please sit here for a moment, I will come back shortly.
questions.correctAnswer: Please sit here for a moment, my brother will come shortly.

questions.sentence: Tumi to amar theke onek choto, amake tumi bolte paro.
options: Na, ami apnake apni kore bolbo.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, ami apnake apni kore bolbo.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I will keep addressing you with the polite form.

questions.sentence: Ochena manusher sathe tumi kore kotha bola uchit na.
options: You should not use the informal form with a stranger.
You should not use the polite form with a close friend.
You should not talk to a stranger on the street.
questions.correctAnswer: You should not use the informal form with a stranger.

questions.sentence: Dada, Howrah bridge jete hole ki metro dhorte hobe?
options: Na, apni ekhan theke tram dhorun.
Ami roj metro te kaje jai.
Howrah bridge onek boro ekta bridge.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, apni ekhan theke tram dhorun.
questions.translatedSentence: No, take the tram from here.

questions.sentence: Ami boroder pronam kori, karon eta amader niyom.
options: I touch my elders' feet, because that is our custom.
I greet my elders, because they are much older than me.
I respect my elders, but I do not touch their feet.
questions.correctAnswer: I touch my elders' feet, because that is our custom.

questions.sentence: Apni ki amake ektu jaiga deben, ami bosbo?
options: Ami dariye achi karon tram ta bhora.
questions.translatedSentence: Of course, please sit here.

questions.sentence: Arre, onek din por dekha! Tumi eto din kothay chile?
options: Ami Dilli te chilam, kajer jonno jete hoyechilo.
Ami ekhanei thaki, kintu tomake chini na.
Ami kal Kolkata ashbo, tokhon dekha hobe.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami Dilli te chilam, kajer jonno jete hoyechilo.
questions.translatedSentence: I was in Delhi, I had to go there for work.

questions.sentence: Tomake dekhe khub bhalo laglo, karon onek bochor kotha hoyni.
options: It is so good to see you, because we have not spoken in years.
It is so good to see you, because I was thinking about you.
It was good to meet you, but we did not get to talk much.
questions.correctAnswer: It is so good to see you, because we have not spoken in years.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki ekhono Kolkatai thako?
options: Na, ami ekhon Dilli te thaki, kintu prati bochor ashi.
Na, ami Kolkata te thakte chai na.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, ami ekhon Dilli te thaki, kintu prati bochor ashi.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I live in Delhi now, but I come back every year.

questions.sentence: Cholo kothao boshe cha khai, onek kotha bola bakhi ache.
options: Let us sit somewhere and have tea, we have a lot to catch up on.
Let us go home and have tea, I still have a lot of work left.
Let us walk for a while, we can talk on the way.
questions.correctAnswer: Let us sit somewhere and have tea, we have a lot to catch up on.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki ekhono macher jhol ar bhaat bhalobasho?
options: Haan, ekhono roj bhaat ar macher jhol khai.
Haan, kintu ekhon ami khub kom mishti khai.
Na, ami kokhono mach ranna korte parini.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, ekhono roj bhaat ar macher jhol khai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I still eat rice and fish curry every day.

questions.sentence: Ami tram e jachchilam, tokhon hothat tomar dada ke dekhlam.
options: I was going by tram when I suddenly saw your brother.
I was going by metro when I suddenly saw your brother.
I was waiting for the tram when your brother called me.
questions.correctAnswer: I was going by tram when I suddenly saw your brother.

questions.sentence: Onek bochor por Howrah bridge dekhe kemon laglo?
options: Aage jemon chilo temoni ache, dekhe bhalo laglo.
Ami Howrah bridge er upor diye kokhono jaini.
Ami bridge er dike takate bhoy pai.
questions.correctAnswer: Aage jemon chilo temoni ache, dekhe bhalo laglo.
questions.translatedSentence: It is just the way it used to be, it felt good to see it.

questions.sentence: Jodi somoy pao, tahole ekdin amader barite eso.
options: If you get some time, come over to our house one day.
If you get some time, give me a call one day.
When you get some time, we will go over to your house.
questions.correctAnswer: If you get some time, come over to our house one day.

questions.sentence: Ami tahole ekhon ashi, kintu ebar theke phone kore kotha bolbo.
options: Nishchoi phone koro, ami opekkha korbo.
Na, ami kokhono phone dhori na.
Ami tomar phone number ta hariye felechi.
questions.correctAnswer: Nishchoi phone koro, ami opekkha korbo.
questions.translatedSentence: Do call, of course, I will be waiting.
